summary: Allocation wrapper (stdcall): allocates a 48-byte object through the heap wrapper OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, runs a multi-field zero-init constructor over it when the allocation succeeds (otherwise stores 0), writes the resulting object pointer into the output pointer a1, then returns a status derived from a guarded initialization call GuardedCallWithStatus(0). Used by the audio mixer channel initializer path.

operations.description: Guard on the allocation result: if it is non-zero run the constructor, otherwise the stored value is 0.
Run MultiFieldZeroInitConstructor over the freshly allocated block to zero-initialize it.
Store the constructor result (or 0 when allocation failed) into the output pointer a1 (this + 0x0).
Invoke GuardedCallWithStatus(0) to validate a subsequent initialization step.
Negate the boolean of the guarded-call result: returns -1 when it is non-zero, 0 when it is zero.
Return the computed status (-1 for non-zero guarded-call status, 0 otherwise).
Called by AudioMixerChannelInitializer (0x005435D0) to obtain a ready audio channel object.

unresolved: What GuardedCallWithStatus(0) validates and whether a non-zero return means success or failure is unknown.
